*Captians Log, Day 1 in the Empire City. At last I am home, however the rumors of change have surely been proven true. I have yet to see the bustle of the city during the day yet I can already see the effects come nightfall. After three days up at mast I unfortunately was all knackered up after unloading the cargo. I feel quite embarrassed but life has a peculiar way of getting lively even at night. I took a night time jaunt through the Hamstead on my way to Central Park, it seemed better than doing bugger all back at my ship, and while I was going through what I thought was going to be an empty street like I remembered from my youth I was greet by a small ruckus in the distance. Deciding to just pass through I couldn't help but shake a strong feeling of unease as not only when entered the burrough the feeling left as soon as I had taken leave of it. The streets were being patrolled by soldiers to find people breaking curfew and walking about when there not supposed to, and I have more than a few inklings of an idea why. The people here are not all to fond of the occupation here and may try to take action, but the streets of Hamstead are not safe. There's rumor of folk missing. The French siege was but a year ago, the wounds I saw were still scarred over and there may still be sympathizers left. I wish the people would understand that it's only a ploy to undermine the strength of the crown, yet I digress for now. 
More peculiar though tonight I received a sign from the Gods, Along my way through central park I stumbled into a dreamlike event. A BLOODY UNICORN AND LION! By the gods and kings might I was about to let the blessed creature be killed by the Lion, yet i was reluctant to take the beast out myself. In the end I was forced to as the beast turned on me and I was unable to scare it off. It nearly took me out as well.*
